div.div: فَلُّوجَةٌ Land that is put into a right, or proper, state for sowing; (S, O, K;) good, clear, land prepared for sowing: (TA:) pl. فَلَالِيجُ. (S, O, K.) And [hence, app.,] Any one town, or village, of the Sawád: (O, K: *) pl. as above. (O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
